_comment: ViNT (visual navigation transformer): two EfficientNet-b0 encoders over a 6-frame observation stack plus a goal image, a 4-layer/4-head transformer over the resulting 7 tokens, and a waypoint head. modelblaster ingests it through torch.export rather than FX (EfficientNet's len() calls and MultiheadAttention's lowered form defeat symbolic_trace), and this flow does the same. Cut at the compress projections: the monolith runs nowhere but CPU, while the encoder tile — 74M of its 88.7M MACs — composes on DSP and runs 6.8x faster there than the whole net does on CPU fp32.
